article.headline: The Record Record — A Legal & Technical Manifesto on Domain Provenance vs. Generative Conflation
article.description: A public legal-style manifesto and shippable technical blueprint: why Google acts as a primary publisher when its AI invents connections between unrelated entities, and the exact code premium-domain owners can ship to force platform-level disambiguation.
